title: Ghee Rice (Neichoru)

ingredients.item: water (1 cup per cup of rice)

steps: Heat the ghee. Sauté the cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, star anise and bay leaf until fragrant.
Add the onion and sauté. Add the cashews and sauté until golden, then the raisins briefly (not too many; they burn).
Let the onion sweat until soft.
Add the water (1 cup per cup of rice), a squeeze of lime or lemon and the salt. Bring to a boil.
Add the washed rice. The water temperature will drop, so bring it back to a boil while stirring.
Once boiling, reduce the heat to low or medium-low and cover with a well-sealing lid, so steam doesn't escape easily.
When most of the water is absorbed, mix gently so the rice doesn't clump or stick to the bottom. Cover again.
When all the water is absorbed, turn off the heat and let the rice steam, covered, for about 10 minutes before opening. Serve.

subs.swap: jasmine rice (same 1:1 water); basmati needs about 1½ cups water per cup
skip, or a pinch of citric acid
almonds or fried onions; or leave out

notes: 2026-10-12 — just be careful for rice to not stick to the bottom of the pan. stir occasionally to avoid this.
